‘No joke from me here’ comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The passage does not say the pride described earlier is gone.
‘All they ask for is his name’ leaves out their request to take away their disgrace.
‘One request’ overlooks the women’s request to take away their disgrace.

The verse says the fruit will be the survivors’ pride and glory; it does not say they keep it.
The passage does not say this cleansing is good news for anyone who has ever felt stained; it speaks of Zion and Jerusalem.
